baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence خاشعة أبصارهم ترهقهم ذلة binds lowered sight to an overpowering humiliation.
baseline_models.mechanism: The eyes become the visible site where an enveloping force converts status-loss into involuntary bodily submission.

activation_trace.role: Low humble submission supplies the lowered bodily posture and assigns it to the eyes.
Literal eyesight identifies the affected organ and makes the abasement visibly embodied.
Covering and overpowering supplies the pressure by which humiliation takes possession of them.
Breakage under domination specifies coerced disgrace rather than gentle humility.

changed_reading.before: Their eyes are downcast because they feel ashamed.
changed_reading.after: Humiliation acts upon them as an enveloping power that physically brings the organ of sight low.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أبصارهم can carry both eyesight and inward recognition, while خاشعة can image a luminary sinking from view.
baseline_models.mechanism: External vision and inward certainty lose their former altitude together when the severe event dominates the field of perception.

activation_trace.role: Inner sight supplies recognition and self-witness beneath the literal lowered eyes.
A luminary sinking from sight supplies the loss of perceptual height.
An overpowering cover supplies the force that closes their former visual and inward horizon.
The day as a severe occurrence makes perception collapse before an event rather than before an abstraction.

changed_reading.before: Only the direction of their physical gaze changes.
changed_reading.after: Their physical gaze and their former inward assessment sink together under the event now seen for what it is.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذلك اليوم الذي كانوا يوعدون identifies the present scene as the day repeatedly held before them.
baseline_models.mechanism: A threatened appointment passes from prior speech into a severe occurrence present in time; the demonstrative closes the gap between warning and realization.

activation_trace.role: Day as a grave occurrence supplies the eventive weight of the demonstrative.
Occurrence and presence in time turns what used to be said into what now stands before them.
The threat branch specifies that the prior promise carried menace rather than open hope.
The appointed-time branch gives the warning a fixed temporal destination.

changed_reading.before: The verse labels a future day that had been predicted.
changed_reading.after: The verse points to the realized appointment: an old threat has become the severe occurrence now governing their bodies.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised day is not only scheduled; it arrives as painful punishment that falls and settles with no successful deflection, explaining why humiliation can overtake them as a force.

activation_trace.role: Inflicted pain and penalty supplies the concrete content of the threatened appointment.
Falling and becoming fixed supplies irreversible arrival rather than a merely verbal forecast.
Pushing harm aside supplies the deflective action that the verse explicitly denies.
The appointed-time image anchors the arriving punishment in the focus promise.
Overpowering cover renders the event's arrival as pressure on the people themselves.

structural_cues: 70:1-2 opens with an asked-about punishment described as واقع and immediately negates any دافع.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: punishment, falling fixation, and negated deflection. Reader arrow: an unpushable event realizes the appointment and exerts the covering pressure in 70:44. Live alternative: the link may be juridical fulfillment rather than spatial descent.

changed_reading.before: The promised day is a date on which shame happens.
changed_reading.after: The promised day is the unpushable arrival whose settling impact becomes the humiliation covering them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The lowered gaze becomes the final failure of a measuring and seeing apparatus: an immense duration was assessed as far, but the same event was near and now occupies their visual field.

activation_trace.role: A quantity reaching its set limit supplies the apparently immense temporal scale.
Eye and insight together make their judgment of distance a perceptual assessment.
The repeated seeing branch supplies the counter-assessment of the same event.
Distance opposed to nearness supplies their mistaken horizon.
Temporal nearness supplies the event's approach despite its perceived remoteness.
Inner sight anchors the failed assessment in the focus eyes.
Lowered submission gives the perceptual defeat a bodily endpoint.

structural_cues: 70:4's fifty-thousand-year measure is followed by 70:6-7's explicit opposition between their far and the speaker's near.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: measured duration and two opposed acts of seeing, far versus near. Reader arrow: the downcast eyes register the collapse of their miscalibrated horizon. Live alternative: far and near may concern knowledge of timing without directly motivating the final posture.

changed_reading.before: The eyes lower in undifferentiated fear.
changed_reading.after: The eyes lower as defeated instruments of judgment when the event they placed far away becomes inescapably present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Height and solidity fail across the scene: elevated sky becomes molten matter and the hard raised mountain becomes soft wool, so the lowered human gaze reads as the local bodily register of a world-wide leveling.

activation_trace.role: Elevation supplies the high visual register that will lose stability.
Molten substances and sediment supply the sky's loss of fixed form.
A hard elevated mass supplies the stable landmark that is undone.
Soft dyed wool supplies the mountain's transformed texture and loss of resistance.
Low flattened ground supplies a material analogue for the downcast focus posture.
Literal sight locates cosmic leveling in the human visual field.

structural_cues: The parallel وتكون clauses of 70:8-9 transform sky and mountains through paired material similes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: elevated sky, molten matter, hard mountain, and soft wool. Reader arrow: the focus gaze is the human-scale continuation of that leveling. Live alternative: the cosmic and bodily changes may be juxtaposed consequences without an analogical arrow between them.

changed_reading.before: Downcast eyes are an isolated emotional gesture.
changed_reading.after: The eyes participate in the same collapse of height and firmness that has already overtaken the visible world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Forced visibility activates a failed social exchange: intimate relations are made perceptible, then offered as substitutes, yet no separation secures escape; the lowered eyes therefore carry exposed relational betrayal as well as fear.

activation_trace.role: Literal seeing supplies forced recognition of the people one would trade away.
Making one thing ransom another supplies the attempted substitution of relations for self.
Escape by separation supplies the desired result that the expanding ransom cannot achieve.
Inner sight turns the final lowered eyes into self-witness after forced recognition.
Humiliation under power supplies the public consequence of the failed exchange.

structural_cues: 70:11-14 expands the proposed ransom from children through spouse, brother, clan, and everyone on earth before the wished-for rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: made-visible relations, substitution, and escape by separation. Reader arrow: the final eyes lower under exposed willingness to sacrifice every bond. Live alternative: the ransom list may indicate terror alone rather than relational shame.

changed_reading.before: The final humiliation is private dread before punishment.
changed_reading.after: The final humiliation is also public self-recognition after every intimate bond has been mentally offered for escape.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sequence of self-protective concealment and containment reverses direction: truth is covered and goods are enclosed, but punishment strips what is fixed in place and humiliation becomes the cover that cannot be controlled.

activation_trace.role: Blocking truth supplies the initial act of controlled concealment.
Pulling something from its settled place supplies punitive exposure and stripping.
Enclosing a thing in a vessel supplies the hoarder's chosen mode of containment.
An overpowering cover reverses concealment by making humiliation the container around them.
Coerced abasement specifies the content of the uncontrollable final cover.

structural_cues: 70:16-18 moves from stripping extremities to calling the one who turned away, gathered, and stored.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: concealment, extraction, storage, and overpowering cover. Reader arrow: chosen covering and containment invert into exposure followed by an imposed cover. Live alternative: these may be cumulative punishments without a measure-for-measure reversal.

changed_reading.after: Humiliation is an inverted covering: those who concealed and contained are stripped, then enclosed by the disgrace they cannot manage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The central exception separates two kinds of low posture: sustained chosen worship joined to fearful care culminates in honor, while the focus lowering is delayed, imposed, and explicitly joined to disgrace.

activation_trace.role: The specific act of worship supplies a repeated voluntary bodily orientation.
Care mixed with fear supplies anticipatory responsiveness before the day arrives.
Honored nobility supplies the outcome paired with chosen discipline.
Humble lowering anchors the shared posture while leaving its voluntariness open.
Breakage under domination resolves the focus posture as compulsory disgrace.

structural_cues: The exception إلا المصلين begins the central list, repeated prayer language frames it at 70:23 and 70:34, and 70:35 closes with honor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: sustained worship, fearful care, honor, and focus abasement. Reader arrow: the middle section offers an earlier voluntary form of lowering opposed to the compelled final posture. Live alternative: the passage may contrast groups and outcomes without intentionally mirroring bodily postures.

changed_reading.before: خشوع and ذلة form one undifferentiated state of lowliness.
changed_reading.after: The focus exposes delayed submission: a posture that could have been chosen in sustained worship arrives instead as coercive humiliation.

context_deltas.mechanism: One crowd trajectory is reversed at its endpoint: fixed forward attention and hopeful approach toward the messenger become rapid emergence and movement toward a visible upright target, but the focus rotates the visual axis downward and replaces hoped-for entry with disgrace.

activation_trace.role: Sustained forward-directed sight supplies the crowd's initial visual axis.
Hopeful appetite supplies the motive attached to their first approach.
Bringing something out from concealment supplies forced exposure from burial.
The grave supplies the enclosure from which the terminal movement begins.
The opposite of slowness supplies the compulsory pace of the final approach.
An upright conspicuous object supplies the target that pulls the rush forward.
Literal eyes anchor the reversal in the same visual faculty that had faced forward.
Lowering supplies the downward rotation at the movement's terminal frame.
Coerced disgrace replaces the garden-entry hope that drove the earlier approach.

structural_cues: 70:36-38 aligns forward attention, right-and-left clustering, and hope of garden entry.
The simile and يُوفِضُون in 70:43 add directed rushing; و ف ض is used only as a branchless structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: fixed gaze, desire, emergence from graves, speed, an upright target, and lowered focus eyes. Reader arrow: these are stages of one approach whose visual axis and value reverse. Live alternative: the earlier gathering and resurrection rush may be separate scenes rather than a deliberate mirror.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a static portrait after resurrection.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the terminal frame of a failed approach: the crowd still moves toward a target, but its formerly eager forward gaze has been forced down.

context_deltas.mechanism: Aimless involvement is bounded by حتى and terminates in a face-to-face encounter with an appointed time; the focus demonstrative then identifies the encountered object as this very day and the old threat as present fact.

activation_trace.role: Entering deeply into talk or an affair supplies their ongoing absorption before the boundary.
Action without a sound purpose supplies the squandered activity that fills the interval.
Two opposed things coming face to face turns temporal arrival into encounter.
A promise fixed to time or place identifies what their activity eventually meets.
The day as a severe occurrence supplies the now-present object of encounter.
Presence in time supplies the conversion from repeated warning to realized scene.
The threat branch anchors the encounter's hostile character in the focus wording.

structural_cues: The terminative حتى in 70:42 leads directly through the resurrection motion of 70:43 into the identifying ذلك of 70:44.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: aimless involvement, a terminative construction, encounter, repeated appointment, and focus identification. Reader arrow: meeting the day converts prior speech into the present focus event. Live alternative: لقاء may mark only a temporal boundary without personifying the day as an encountered counterpart.

changed_reading.before: The focus recalls a prediction after the predicted event has begun.
changed_reading.after: The focus names the counterpart they have just met: the appointed threat has crossed from speech into direct encounter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant ع د د target under focus و ع د; it remains anchored in يوم and يوعدون and is reinforced by the measured span in 70:4, but downstream prose should present it as a counting-and-appointment resonance, not as a replacement gloss for يُوعَدُون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ذلك اليوم الذي كانوا يوعدون can be heard as an appointment whose immense interval has been measured and counted to completion.

activation_trace.role: A quantity reaching its limit supplies formal measurement of the long interval.
The number five supplies the first explicit counting unit in fifty.
A thousand as gathered hundreds supplies the scale of the counted span.
Counted time and its return supplies a remote resonance beneath the repeated appointment.
A span of time anchors the counting image in the focus day.
A prescribed counted term supplies the exploratory image of an interval completed.

changed_reading.before: The day is named only by a verbal promise.
changed_reading.after: The day is also heard as a fully counted term whose enormous measure has finally run to its limit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins the non-dominant ع و م swimming target under و ع د to the water image of خوض; it remains anchored because 70:42 places wading before the same promised day repeated in 70:44, but downstream prose should mark it as a temporal-traversal image rather than a lexical equivalence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired يوم and يوعدون allow the promised interval to appear as a medium traversed until it delivers the travelers into the focus scene.

activation_trace.role: Entering water supplies the explicit medium-traversal image.
Swimming or gliding motion supplies an exploratory current beneath the repeated promised day.
A duration of time anchors the imagined current in the focus day.
The same swimming branch at the focus occurrence carries the traversal image to its endpoint.

changed_reading.before: They spend time until a future date arrives.
changed_reading.after: They move inside time like a current until the promised medium deposits them in the scene where their eyes are forced down.

strongest_changes: The lowered gaze becomes a defeated measuring instrument when the event they saw as distant becomes near and present.
Sustained chosen submission in 70:22-35 is distinguished from the delayed, coerced abasement of 70:44.
The ending becomes a kinetic reversal in which forward fixed attention and hopeful approach terminate in eyes forced downward.
The repeated promise becomes an encountered and unpushable appointment rather than residual speech.
summary.what_was_special: The packet made visual direction, temporal distance, material leveling, social exposure, and covering-versus-exposure converge on the focus eyes; the split و ع د mappings also preserved count and traversal resonances without displacing the dominant threat-and-appointment reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The cosmic-leveling link may be an inferred analogy rather than an intended causal continuation.
The concealment and containment reversal may be rhetorical patterning rather than measure-for-measure mechanism.
The counted-term and temporal-current outliers depend on non-dominant mapped targets and must remain explicitly exploratory.
